sensitivity_band.interpretation: Each multiplier is applied per rung and clipped to [0,1] before mapping latent TV to channel TV. eps_lo summaries and joint fractions are design-time synthetic quantities.

sensitivity_conclusion.structural_test: The registered compression factors are not enough evidence for a joint-fraction claim; the 0.5x-2.0x band is required.
sensitivity_conclusion.coarse_rung_floor_test: At r0/k=5 the floor remains near-constant across the pair set at larger n, but moves upward toward 0.5 as the radius shrinks; the old approximately 0.455 numerical level does not persist.
sensitivity_conclusion.eps_lo_reading: A coarse-rung eps_lo collapse is structural only to the extent that it remains near zero across the compression band; this report does not turn the assumed factors into an empirical conclusion.
sensitivity_conclusion.joint_fraction_citability: Not citable as a corpus result; it depends on assumed compression, synthetic latent TV levels, n, k, and the design-time lower-bound simulation.

eps_hi_clipping_policy.rule: Never silently clip. Print/store raw eps_hi. If raw eps_hi>1, store display eps_hi=1 separately, set floor_from_raw_eps_hi=0, and mark certificate lost or alphabet-invalid.

k_cert_citable.scope: The arithmetic k_cert table is citable under the fixed a-priori ladder and alpha=0.05; this rerun does not upgrade the joint-fraction result to citable status.

surviving_findings: The fixed-grid algebra uses m=(2M)^k and never realized support.
At n=1e4, the fine rungs at k=5 are alphabet-invalid under m>n; this is not evidence against corpus-scale behavior.
At n=2e5 and n=3.9e6, upper-side eligibility must be read alongside the lower-side distribution; k_cert alone is not a joint-fraction result.
The r0 floor is information-poor when channel TV is compressed near zero, even though r0 has the longest certified region.
design_vs_empirical_note: All ensemble rows use a known true channel TV to isolate sample-size and channel-compression effects. Real data must provide empirical tv_hat from the fixed k-prefix grid; real eps_lo requires independent held-out evaluation, and its Michel guarantee is asymptotic rather than finite-sample.
known_limitations: Compression factors are author-chosen design values, not measured traffic quantities.
The synthetic laws occupy three cells, but the certificate uses the full fixed a-priori m.
The operational alphabet-invalid flag m>n is a declared diagnostic for this rerun, not a replacement theorem for the finite-alphabet bound.
The lower side is an asymptotic Michel HPLB and is not a finite-sample certificate.
The joint fraction uses ten synthetic pair levels and cannot establish a real-corpus gate.
No realized support or data-dependent grid is substituted into m.
blockers: No real per-service pair distributions were provided, so this remains a design-time rerun and cannot resolve the empirical Q1 verdict.
